title: Existentialism
learning_outcomes: Explain freedom and responsibility in the context of existentialism.
Compare and distinguish existentialist thinkers in the context of existentialism.
Apply authenticity and constraints in the context of existentialism.
Evaluate and justify decisions about objections in the context of existentialism.

lessons.title: Freedom and responsibility
lessons.outcome: Explain freedom and responsibility in the context of existentialism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving freedom and responsibility; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to existential dilemma essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain freedom and responsibility from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of freedom and responsibility; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Existentialist thinkers
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish existentialist thinkers in the context of existentialism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving existentialist thinkers; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to existential dilemma essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain existentialist thinkers from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of existentialist thinkers; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Authenticity and constraints
lessons.outcome: Apply authenticity and constraints in the context of existentialism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving authenticity and constraints; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to existential dilemma essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain authenticity and constraints from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of authenticity and constraints; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Objections
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about objections in the context of existentialism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving objections; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to existential dilemma essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain objections from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of objections; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of freedom and responsibility; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of existentialist thinkers; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of authenticity and constraints; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of objections; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Philosopher or scholar of relevant tradition; avoid treating one tradition as universal.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
